ice_tolerance.position_policy: signed normal displacement divided by declared local nominal length
ice_tolerance.direction_policy: signed transverse drift/run relative to the original rink axis
ice_tolerance.shared_by: entire event scene, all shots and cameras
ice_tolerance.nominal_constraints_ref: constraints describe the nominal template; effective metric ties have the declared tolerance
